observations.Butterfree: D1 often has bold contours or black backgrounds; one D1 optimization image remains white-backed. Poses/crops vary.
observations.Clefable: D0 mostly pale/white-backed; D1 includes vivid scenes and black-backed sprites.
observations.Clefairy: D1 outlines and black backgrounds stand out; D0 includes pale renders and lighter pixel art. Similar-looking sprites are not exact duplicates.
observations.Cubone: D0 mainly light/soft; D1 includes darker scenes, black background and strongly outlined colored artwork. Media differ.
observations.Dratini: D1 contains high-contrast black panels and detailed water scenes; D0 includes pale simple depictions and a soft rendered scene.
observations.Dugtrio: Contrast is weaker: both domains contain detailed scenes and outlined sprites, with D1 tending stronger light-dark separation.
observations.Exeggcute: D0 is mostly pale/soft; D1 contains stronger outlines and dark or vivid scenes, plus black-backed line art.
observations.Gyarados: D1 tends detailed high contrast/dark backgrounds; a busy bright D0 card is a counterexample to a simple complexity label.
observations.Ivysaur: D1 often black-backed or stronger-edged; D0 lighter/flatter. Pixel-art/media differences confound appearance.
observations.Poliwag: D1 often stronger outlining/contrast; D0 includes an already dark low-poly rendering. Not a brightness-only split.
observations.Primeape: D0 muted tan/soft backgrounds; D1 black-backed sprites/renders and strong green contours. Pose/crop varies.
observations.Seaking: D0 softer scenic renders; D1 stronger contours and contrasting panels; white-backed drawing shows D1 need not be dark.
observations.Shellder: D1 sharper contrast in several samples but white-backed soft render overlaps D0 appearance; media and crop vary.
observations.Tentacool: D1 repeatedly uses black or high-contrast backgrounds, D0 pale/soft scenes. One D1 white-background example remains.
observations.Venusaur: D1 very heterogeneous: black-backed sprite, white-background line art, dark object and detailed card. D0 often softer color scenes.
observations.Weepinbell: D0 mostly softly lit toy/render depictions; D1 black-backed crisp sprites, vivid scene and one dark render.

recurrence: Repeated stronger light-dark contrast/edges and frequent black backgrounds in D1, relative to often paler/softer D0; weaker and heterogeneous in Dugtrio, Shellder, Venusaur.
uncertainty: Unblinded small fixed subset; visual observations are qualitative. Pose, object scale, media, background and fine-detail differences co-vary. No semantic-style or class-correctness inference. Similar non-identical images remain possible across pools.
